faq.q: What is the origin of Ilmi?

faq.a: In Urdu, Ilmi is rendered علمی and carries the sense علمی، علمیاتی، دانشورانہ.

faq.q: What does Ilmi mean in Persian?

faq.q: What are the variants of Ilmi?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Ilmi, ilmi. Script forms are علمي, علمی, इल्मी.

faq.q: Is Ilmi a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
